The instrument features a rich reddish-brown wooden case with multiple sections of vertical silver metallic pipes of varying heights. The central section has the tallest pipes, flanked by shorter pipes in symmetrical arrangements. Below the main pipe array is a lower section with additional smaller pipes and a decorative panel. To the left, a Gothic-style arched window with leaded glass is visible. To the right, a warm-toned hanging lamp and part of a statue are visible. The perspective is from below, looking up at the instrument.
